page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page, p. 89): one text column with the running head at top; a signature and catchword at the foot. Edge fragments of the neighbouring page on the far left are not transcribed.

main_text.l: SCENA SECUNDA
Exhibens denunciationem sententiae, adversus
ingratos rupis salutis occisores prolatae
§. 1. Scenae secundae ratio.
PRodit hic aliquis quasi ex foro divino in pu-
blicum, qui post peractam κατηγορίαν & ab-
solutam litis contestationem palam denunciat,
quid per divinam sententiam adversus ingra-
tos illos rupis salutis occisores & degeneres illos Jaco-
bi posteros per modum poenae statutum sit. Proin
concipio hic eundem Mosen, qui in scena praecedenti
egerat κατήγορον, nunc quasi alio in loco inter homines
agere sententiae contra apostatas Judæos latae praeco-
nem; atque inter primum sermonem & hunc
aliquam concipiendam esse moram existimo, sententiae pro-
nunciationi, quatenus est Judicis opus, tribuendam,
eamque concipi ut in arcano Dei foro conclusam, &
ad priorem convictionem definitam, sed jam quasi alio
in loco extra illud forum per aliquem Judicis istius ministrum
propalandam.
ARgumentum hujus praeconii est Judicis sententiam,
poenam in foro statutam definientem, cum

page.notes: The initial letter is a decorative capital; read as P (Prodit), marked as doubtful. The Greek words κατηγορίαν and κατήγορον are copied as printed. The catchword "pulo" is partly worn and may be incomplete; the printed paragraph ends mid-word at "po-". The page number 89 is partly faded. Edge fragments of the neighbouring page on the far left are excluded.
